'''Richard Law''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Greenwood tournament]] on 24 March 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1960">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-greenwood-in-3-24-01d1960/ greenwood-in-3-24-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 26 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-greenwood-in-3-24-01d1960/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
